title: 3.8.14 Lab: Handle a Malformed JSON String
description: Write a function that parses text and returns a usable fallback instead of letting a bad string stop the program. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Write the parsing function
steps.instructions: Define a function named readSave that takes one parameter, a string. Inside it, attempt to parse the text with JSON.parse.

steps.title: Guard the parse with try/catch
steps.instructions: Wrap the JSON.parse call in a try block. In the catch block, return a fallback object with a property such as ok set to false, instead of letting the error escape.

steps.title: Test both paths
steps.instructions: Use console.log to call the function twice: once with a valid JSON string and once with garbage. Confirm the first returns a value and the second returns your fallback.
